instruction: Visit Sarathi Parivahan and select your state.
Apply for Learner's Licence and pay fees.
Take the online learner's test.
After the mandatory period, apply for the driving licence.
Book and pass the driving test at the RTO.
Receive the DL by post / download.
Visit DigiLocker web/app and sign up.
Enter Aadhaar-linked mobile and verify OTP.
Set a security PIN and link Aadhaar.
Fetch issued documents from partner departments.
Register on the National Scholarship Portal.
Complete OTR (One Time Registration) with Aadhaar/eKYC.
Login and select applicable scholarship scheme.
Fill the form and upload documents.
Submit for institution and department verification.
Visit the Income Tax e-filing portal.
Select 'Instant e-PAN' (Aadhaar-based) or apply via NSDL/UTIITSL.
Enter Aadhaar number and validate OTP.
Confirm details and submit.
Download e-PAN in PDF format.
Login to the Income Tax e-filing portal with PAN.
Select the applicable ITR form and assessment year.
Verify pre-filled data and enter income/deductions.
Compute tax, pay any dues, and submit.
E-verify via Aadhaar OTP/net banking within the allowed window.
Visit the Udyam Registration portal.
Enter Aadhaar number and validate OTP.
Enter PAN and business details (turnover, investment, activity).
Submit the form and validate.
Download the Udyam Registration Certificate with URN.
Locate a nearby Aadhaar Seva Kendra / enrolment centre.
Book an appointment online via myAadhaar or walk in.
Fill the enrolment form and submit POI/POA documents.
Provide biometrics (fingerprints, iris, photo).
Collect the acknowledgement slip with Enrolment ID (EID).
Check Aadhaar status online and download e-Aadhaar once generated.
Register on the Passport Seva Online Portal.
Login and fill 'Apply for Fresh/Reissue of Passport'.
Pay the fee online and schedule a PSK appointment.
Visit the PSK with original documents for verification.
Complete police verification (if applicable).
Track status; passport is dispatched by post.
Visit the PM-KISAN portal and select 'New Farmer Registration'.
Enter Aadhaar and complete OTP verification.
Fill land and bank details.
Submit; complete eKYC (Aadhaar OTP/biometric).
Track beneficiary status online.
Check eligibility on the PM-JAY beneficiary portal.
Authenticate via Aadhaar OTP.
Complete KYC and photo capture.
Download the Ayushman card once approved.
Visit the e-Shram self-registration portal.
Enter Aadhaar-linked mobile and validate OTP.
Fill personal, address, occupation and bank details.
Submit and download the e-Shram card with UAN.
Register/login on Aaple Sarkar (RTS) portal.
Select Revenue Department > Income Certificate.
Fill applicant details and upload documents.
Pay the fee online.
Track application; download the digitally signed certificate.
Login to Aaple Sarkar portal.
Select Revenue Department > Age Nationality and Domicile Certificate.
Fill the form and upload documents.
Pay fees and submit.
Download the digitally signed certificate.
Register on the Ladki Bahin portal or Narishakti Doot app.
Enter Aadhaar and personal details.
Upload eligibility documents.
Submit and note the application number.
Track approval and DBT credit status.
